title: Reaves Returns, Kessler Out: Lakers Update
text:
Austin Reaves makes his preseason debut after an ankle injury, but Walker Kessler and other players remain sidelined for the Lakers' game against the Kings.
Austin Reaves returned to the Lakers lineup on Thursday after missing two preseason games due to an ankle injury sustained in practice. While Reaves was back, the team was without several other players: Walker Kessler (jammed finger), Ziaire Williams (hip), Collin Sexton (groin), Dalton Knecht (ankle), Cameron Carr (ankle), and two-way forward Arthur Kaluma.
Head coach JJ Redick indicated that Kessler's injury is not a long-term concern, with an evaluation scheduled for Friday, and expects him to participate in one of the remaining three preseason games before the regular season begins.
